The '''S-s3a long range tachyon detection scanner''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] device manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. The scanner was used in [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]].
